cards.question: What does mutex stand for, and what does it guarantee?
cards.answer: Mutual exclusion. It works as an exclusive reference: only one thread can hold the lock at a time.

cards.question: What happens when threads conflict on a mutex?
cards.answer: Conflicting access does not cause a panic. Waiting threads are put to sleep and woken up when the lock is released.
